notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-inquire-deleteq (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): INQUIRE ASSOCIATION(EIBTASKN) origin data (ODAPPLID, ODUSERID, ODFACILNAME, ODNETWORKID, ODFACILTYPE as a CVDA), DELETEQ TS (the whole queue and its NEXT position, QIDERR, INVREQ for a name of binary zeros), RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: origin
scenarios.why: INQUIRE ASSOCIATION(EIBTASKN) with all five origin options (RESP / RESP2), then with two of them: the stated origin, ODFACILTYPE as the CVDA 213

scenarios.name: deleteq
scenarios.why: DELETEQ TS removes the queue with its items and NEXT position (QIDERR afterwards, and for a second delete); a queue written anew starts at item 1; a name of binary zeros is INVREQ

scenarios.name: receive-terminal
scenarios.why: SEND MAP, then RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL ASIS: the input of the terminal that started the task

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)

scenarios.name: receive-asis
scenarios.why: HC62, the RETURN TRANSID of the earlier legs: RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL ASIS and its log
